purpose: Diagnose confidence-policy initialization sensitivity and record validation learning curves without changing completed studies.
initial_artifacts: Existing seed-matched initial SFT artifacts, pinned manifest hashes required before execution
initialization_conditions: zero final policy projection and bias, uniform 21-bin policy
reference: Same frozen original supervised joint policy for both initializations. Reset only final policy layer; preserve shared projections, scalar head and answer scores.
validation: Fixed validation-only subset and source hashes must be frozen before execution; never use calibration or test for stopping or selection.
learning_rate: Existing validation-selected per-method rate, identical across initialization conditions; no new LR sweep
other_hyperparameters: Use original 0.8B configuration, eight samples and original KL beta, fixed matched exposure and candidate RNG
diagnostics: policy expected confidence by candidate correctness
required_preflight: Confirm same answer and scalar outputs immediately after final-policy reset
Verify exact/sample gradient matching on synthetic cases
Measure 100-update fit pilot within the declared budget
stopping: Primary comparison uses fixed 500 updates for matched exposure. Validation curves diagnose progress but do not prove convergence. Any patience-based extension needs a separate freeze and is secondary, since unequal stopping changes data exposure.
limitations: Proposed after completed findings. One backbone size and fixed LR cannot isolate every cause of sampled weakness. Changing initialization also changes initial distance from reference; report this explicitly. No execution authorized by this file itself and no results are claimed.
